description: Log a new bird inventory census batch. Supports confirm and idempotency validation.

confirm.description: Set to true to commit, false for dry-run preview

hatchDate.description: The hatch date (YYYY-MM-DD, cannot be in the future)

location.description: Current location (Brooder, Grow-out, Layer, Breeder, Other)

quantity.description: The number of birds in the batch (positive finite integer <= 50000)

name: log_bird_batch
